questions.prompt: Where should LLM API calls be made from in a web product?
options: Your backend, keeping the API key secret and enforcing auth/limits
questions.explanation: Keys are secrets and the server enforces auth, data minimisation, validation and cost control.

questions.prompt: An LLM API remembers earlier requests, so you only need to send the newest message.
questions.explanation: The API is stateless; you resend whatever context is needed each time.

questions.prompt: The model returns JSON that doesn't match your schema. Correct handling?
options: Pass it to the frontend anyway
Validate (Zod), retry once, then return a clean error/fallback
questions.explanation: Model output is untrusted input; validate and handle failures.

questions.prompt: /ai/summary only needs times, service names and status. Which data should the prompt include?
options: Full booking rows including phone and email
Only the fields needed (time, service, status)
questions.explanation: Send the minimum fields to an approved provider.

questions.prompt: Which is the strongest protection against a tricked assistant cancelling bookings?
options: A stern 'NEVER cancel' in the prompt
Least privilege + confirmation + same auth as the user enforced in code
questions.explanation: Prompts aren't security boundaries; code-level permissions and confirmation are.

questions.prompt: Which belong in a good RAG answer step?
options: Say 'I don't know' when not covered
questions.explanation: Ground, cite and abstain; never treat documents as instructions.

questions.prompt: Production uses a different embedding model than your dev ingest. What happens?
options: Vectors aren't comparable, so retrieval quality collapses; use the same model everywhere
questions.explanation: Different models produce incomparable vector spaces (and dimensions).

questions.prompt: Why can a price table chunked arbitrarily return the wrong price?
options: A price may be separated from its service label, so the retrieved chunk is ambiguous
questions.explanation: Keep rows with headers/labels in the same chunk.

questions.prompt: The model emits create_booking. What should the server do?
options: Store a pending action; execute only via the user's authenticated Confirm request
Ask the model to confirm itself
questions.explanation: Model text must never trigger side effects; a separate user action does.

questions.prompt: A tool call has starts_at '2026-03-02T10:00:00' (no offset). Best action?
options: Reject it and ask for an offset/time zone
questions.explanation: Ambiguous times cause wrong-hour bookings; require an explicit offset.

questions.prompt: Why include 'not in documents' and attack cases in your eval set?
options: They test abstention and safety behaviours that happy-path cases miss
questions.explanation: Failures cluster in edge and adversarial cases.

questions.prompt: Cost per chat turn keeps increasing within a conversation. Likely cause?
options: The full history is resent every turn
questions.explanation: Stateless APIs resend history; trim or summarise it.

questions.prompt: A user exceeds their daily token limit. The API should return:
questions.explanation: 429 Too Many Requests, ideally with Retry-After and a human message.
